perceive_minecraft_environment: run the LowLevelMCPerception perceive method to update mob, item, and block positions in memory
update_player_memory: call update_self_memory to write the current player position, pitch, and yaw to the ReferenceObjects table
update_other_players: call update_other_players with a player list to update their positions and create or update attention nodes
handle_block_changes: call on_block_changed with xyz and idm to remove inst segments, update block memory, and merge adjacent block objects
check_block_interesting: call is_placed_block_interesting with xyz and block id to determine if a placed block is interesting, player-placed, or agent-placed
